ruleDefinitions.name: Unsigned Binary Loaded From Suspicious Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Code Integrity (CI) engine blocking processes from loading unsigned DLLs residing in suspicious locations Note: Unmapped fields: ImageName

sequences.query: ((event_id = 11 OR event_id = 12) AND (ImageName = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR ImageName = RGX(".*\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR ImageName = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR ImageName = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR ImageName = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR ImageName = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\TEMP\\\\.*")))
